name: Rafael Costa
bio:
Rafael's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood in São Paulo, watching Ayrton Senna dominate the Formula 1 circuit. Inspired by the legendary driver's charisma and global appeal, Rafael pursued a career in communications, aiming to bridge the gap between racing teams and their fans. He honed his skills in journalism and public relations, eventually landing a role with a local racing publication.

Driven by a desire to make a bigger impact, Rafael transitioned into motorsports PR. He believes in crafting compelling narratives that highlight the dedication, innovation, and sheer thrill of the sport. He is eager to learn from experienced professionals and contribute his unique perspective to a winning team. Calm under pressure and fiercely loyal, Rafael is determined to establish himself as a valuable asset in the high-octane world of motorsport.

He is a staunch advocate for diversity and inclusion in the sport, aiming to create opportunities and promote voices from all backgrounds. Rafael's youthful enthusiasm and unwavering dedication make him a rising star in the PR world, ready to make a lasting impact on the sport he loves.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Rafael is of average height with a lean build and an approachable smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
Prefers to conduct meetings while taking a walk.
